items.text: Round 2 decisions incorporated: d1-r2=A (reject entirely-empty modifications payloads with field-violation error), d2-r2=A (strictly accept-once; immutable post-accept), d3-r2=A (no server-side clause matching; operator intent authoritative), d4-r2=C (contract doc is a markdown file in scenarios/prompt-manager/docs/ linked from proto comments, NOT a new steer skill).

Plan is ready for execution. All 5 readiness dimensions at 3/3. Orchestrator should respect sibling sequencing F9 → (F10) → F15 (this item) → F14 and ensure F9/F10/F14 workshops are notified of the modifications contract before they run.

Codebase investigation (Current Technical Context section) deliberately remains TBD — it requires the prompt-manager scenario source tree at execute time. Plan directs the execute-time agent to use the existing `notes` field plumbing as the structural template and lists the five investigation targets.

Noted risk on d4-r2=C: markdown-in-docs is less discoverable to skill-scanning agents than a steer skill would be. Mitigated via proto-comment links and explicit workshop-agent prompt citation in Phase 4. Captured in the Risks table so the orchestrator can revisit if downstream consumers miss the doc.

plan_updates: Added Settled Decisions (round 2) table capturing d1-r2 through d4-r2. Rewrote Phase 4 to pin contract doc to scenarios/prompt-manager/docs/ with proto-comment links (per d4-r2=C). Added immutability rule to Validation Policy and Contract Decisions sections (per d2-r2=A). Added API unit test for post-accept immutability and added prohibited pattern against an edit/amend path. Added risk row covering discoverability tradeoff of docs/-based contract vs a steer skill, with mitigation. Scope in/out updated to call out immutability and the chosen doc venue. Readiness lifted to 3/3 across all dimensions.
